purpose: verify that aggregate committed-profile observables reconstruct from the committed node state
quantify node-level pressure-head and water-content differences hidden by aggregate observables
resolve the geometry/unit semantics of W_profile, root-water and M1 for the four-node carrier
determine whether another forcing search on this carrier is scientifically justified

carrier_scope.solver: real HeadCalc serialized-reference route with explicit B110 constitutive provider
carrier_scope.geometry_semantics: metre-scale as documented by the research bridge
carrier_scope.hydraulic_head_semantics: native HeadCalc pressure-head coordinate retains centimetre convention

read_only_node_diagnostic.state_source: snapshot of current committed kernel state

sequence_definition.EARLY: PULSE repeated N -> ZERO repeated N -> ZERO repeated R
sequence_definition.LATE: ZERO repeated N -> PULSE repeated N -> ZERO repeated R

representative_histories.rationale: fixed representatives from qualified RZM06A5: R0 carries the plateau timing-memory signal; R50 is the erased-memory control

pair_diagnostics.no_binary_masking_threshold: No post-hoc masking threshold is defined. A6 reports the node vectors and scale ratios; the scientific decision is made from qualified evidence.

controls: all non-baseline histories must replay transactionally with complete mass accounting
failed intervals preserve the latest committed origin
node diagnostic calls before and after repeated reads must leave revision, time, ledger and aggregate observables unchanged
E_c is neither read nor used as a selection variable
H2 thresholds remain unchanged and are not reinterpreted in A6
nonclaims: no H2 support or falsification from A6 alone
no claim that the four-node FSI fixture is representative of a full real-SWAP discretization
